## How to Change the Color of the Footer Area?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-change-the-color-of-the-footer-area/>

Available in **Spacious Pro**

You can change the color of the footer widget title , content and many more.

To change the color of the Footer Widget Area , follow the steps listed below:

- From your WordPress Dashboard, navigate to the **Appearance **> **Customize **> **Footer > Footer Widget Area**
- Scroll to locate **Colors**
- Change the color of the desired section.
- Click on **Publish**.

To change the color of the Footer Bottom Bar , follow the steps listed below:

- From your WordPress Dashboard, navigate to the **Appearance **> **Customize **> **Footer > Footer Bottom Bar**
- Scroll to locate **Colors**
- Change the color of the desired section.
- Click on **Publish**.

## Content Part Color overview

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/content-part-color-overview/>

Available in **Spacious Pro**

You can change the color of Widget title, content text, post meta and many more.

To manage the color in Sidebar Widget Title, follow the steps listed below:

- From your WordPress Dashboard, navigate to the **Appearance **> **Customize **> **Content > Sidebar**
- Go to **Colors.**
- Change the color of the desired section.
- Click on **Publish**.

To manage the color in Content, follow the steps listed below:

- From your WordPress Dashboard, navigate to the **Appearance **> **Customize **> **Global > Colors.**
- Go to ** Base Colors.**
- Change the color of the desired section.
- Click on **Publish**.

To manage the color in Post Meta, follow the steps listed below:

- From your WordPress Dashboard, navigate to the **Appearance **> **Customize **> **Content > Post Meta**
- Go to ** Colors.**
- Change the color of the desired section.
- Click on **Publish**.

## Slider Color Overview

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/slider-color-overview/>

Available in **Spacious Pro**
